overview: You stood by a post on the left. The board gave the title only. A tall boy with a staff, in a buff jerkin and breeches, faced three Spanish swaggerers, and the yard roared. Alleyn was easy in a smaller part. Henslowe at the door counted with his lips and did not show the count. You were looking at the yard more than at the stage.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Stood by the post on the left and followed the yard.

parties.name: Edward Alleyn
parties.context: Played, easy, in a part smaller than himself.

parties.name: Philip Henslowe
parties.context: Counted heads at the door with his lips, and did not show the figure.

assets.name: Long Meg of Westminster
assets.disposition: Stood by the post and looked at the yard
